name: Trivia Night
hook: Quick questions you can change any time.
how: Ten questions, 15 seconds each. Faster right answers score more. Swap the question pack whenever you like.
controls: Click or tap an answer, or press 1 to 4
uses: Questions, timers and scores stay the same for everyone, even when the host leaves.
Quiz bots play until enough people join.
ideas: Make the last question worth double
Make a question pack about movies
